Let \(\vec{OA}=m\vec a\), \(\vec{OB}=n\vec b\), where \(m,n>0\). Since the area is \(1\),

\[
\frac12 mn = 1 \implies mn=2.
\]

Also,

\[
\vec{PA}=\vec{OA}-\vec{OP}=(m-1)\vec a-2\vec b,
\]
\[
\vec{PB}=\vec{OB}-\vec{OP}=-\vec a+(n-2)\vec b.
\]

Because \(\vec a,\vec b\) are perpendicular unit vectors,

\[
\vec{PA}\cdot\vec{PB}=-(m-1)-2(n-2)=5-m-2n.
\]

Now minimize \(m+2n\) subject to \(mn=2\). By AM-GM or calculus,

\[
m+2n=\frac{2}{n}+2n \ge 4,
\]

with equality at \(n=1,m=2\). Therefore,

\[
\vec{PA}\cdot\vec{PB}\le 5-4=1.
\]

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
